## Agent 5: quality check + publish
Started by Agent 4 or the weekly digest (answers at once). Link guard -> quality score -> HTML -> slug check (never overwrites) -> **dry run?** If `run.dryRun` is true it SKIPS the blog API and Telegram and logs whether it would publish or hold. Otherwise **Publish Gate**: any blocker (editor did not check every section, numbers not in the research, another script, too short, no title, score < 6) HOLDS the post: no publish, one alert via the error workflow. Then **Day Already Published?** (blog_runs): if this run, or for a scheduled/retry run that day's scheduled/retry post, is already published, it marks the run `skipped` and stops quietly. Else POST https://your-blog.example/api/blog/posts (3 tries), mark the run published, queue item done, Telegram announcement, learnings tables (posts only).

**Dry run:** start from Agent 1 with `{"dryRun": true}`.
